spans.s:
m. (-त्यः)
A horse, from the Vedas.
E.
अत to go constantly, यत् aff.

mfn. (-यः-था-यं)
Not to be abandoned.
E.
अ neg. त्यजनीय to be abandoned.

mfn. or adv. n. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Much, excessive.
E.
अति beyond, and अन्त end, or boundary.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Very passionate.
E.
अत्यन्त, and कोपन passionate.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
What goes much or quickly.
E.
अत्यन्त, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-रः)
A species of grain, (Panicum Italicum.)
E.
अत्यन्त, and सुकुमार very soft.

m. (-वः)
(In logic) absolute negation or non-existence.
E.
अत्यन्त much, अभाव not being.

m. (-कः)
One who rambles much, a great rover.
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Much, exceeding.
E.
अत्यन्त, with ठक् aff.

Supreme.
2

Excessive, abundant.
3 Infinite.
E.
अत्यन्त exceeding, ठक् aff.

m. (-नः)
One who goes quickly or actively.
E.
अत्यन्त much, and ईन for गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं)
Very sour.
m. (-म्लः)
A tree, (Spondias mangifera.)
f. (-म्ला)
Another plant and fruit; a species of citron. See मातुलुङ्गी.
E.
अति, and अम्ल sour.

f. (-र्णी)
A creeper and medicinal plant.
E.
अति excessive, अम्ल sour; and पर्ण a leaf, with the fem. aff. ङीप्.

Death.
2

Distress.
3

Transgression.
4

Vice, fault, guilt.
5

Punishment.
6

Going over or beyond.
7

Absence.
8

Loss, destruction.
E.
अति beyond, away, इण to go, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Exceeded, surpassed.
2 Outraged.
E.
अति before इण to go, क्त aff.

n. adv. mfn. adj. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Much, excessive.
E.
अति, and अर्थ substance.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Very small, very little.
E.
अति very, and अल्प small.

f. (-ष्टी)
A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with seventeen syllables to the line.
E.
अति beyond, अष्टी another metre.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Very rough, uneven, craggy.
E.
अति, and असम unequal.

m. (-रः)
Censure, blame, contempt.
E.
अति and आङ prefixed to कृ to do, वज् aff.

m. (-रः)
Deviating from prescribed observances, contemning religious and moral laws.
E.
अति, and आचार observance.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Transgressing.
E.
अत्याचार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Not to be abandoned.
E.
अ neg. त्याज्य to be abandoned.

f. (-शा)
Unreasonable hope or desire.
E.
अति, and आशा hope.

m. (-रः)
Excessive food.
E.
अति, and आहार food.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Eating excessively, a glutton, a gormandizer.
E.
अत्याहार, and इनि aff.

n. (-तं)
1 Great dread.
2 Desperate or daring action.
E.
अति, with धा to have; आङ prefixed, and the participial क्त; हि is substituted for धा; what engrosses the mind.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Idle or excessive talk.
2 Expatiating, enlarging.
3 A figure of rhetoric, description of any thing surprising or extraordinary, hyperbole.
E.
अति, and उक्ति speech.

f. (-क्था)
A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with two syllables to the line.
E.
अति, and उक्था another kind: it is also read अत्युक्ता.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Extreme, exceeding great.
E.
अति, and उत्कट much.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टां-ष्टं)
1 Most excellent, best.
2 Most valuable, precious.
E.
अति, and उत्कृष्ट excellent.

m. (-हः)
A gallinule.
f. (-हा)
A plant, (Jasminum villosum, Rox. or in Bengal, Nyctanthes tristis.) See शेफालिका.
E.
अति, and ऊह to reason.

m. (-हः)
A gallinule: see दात्यूह.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Ill-omened, unpropitious.
2

Destructive.
3

Disastrous.
4

Distressing, painful.
E.
अत्यय destruction. ठञ् aff.
